questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) ________ seen that film before.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I don't think that is true,' he said. -> He said that he ________ thought that was true.
Which sentence correctly reports the meaning of 'If I had known you were coming, I would have baked a cake'?
options: She said she would have baked a cake if she had known I was coming.
She said she would bake a cake if she knew I was coming.
She said she would have baked a cake if she had known I was coming.
She said she would bake a cake if she had known I was coming.
questions.answer: She said she would have baked a cake if she had known I was coming.

questions.question: Identify the correct reported speech form: 'I am sure that he will win,' she said. -> She said that she ________ he would win.
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: By the time we arrive, the meeting (probably) ________ already finished by then.
Select the correct form to complete the sentence: If we (not have) ________ such a bad weather forecast, we would have gone hiking yesterday.
Which option correctly completes the sentence? After the presentation, the manager said that the proposal (need) ________ reviewing further.
Choose the correct reported speech form: 'I can't believe it! We've won the competition!' she shouted. -> She said that she couldn't believe it and that they ________ won the competition.
Select the correct option to complete the sentence: If I (be) ________ you, I would take that job.
Which sentence correctly reports the meaning of 'It is likely that she will arrive late'?
options: They said she was likely to arrive late.
They said she might arrive late.
They said she was probably arriving late.
They said she was likely to have arrived late.
questions.answer: They said she was likely to arrive late.
